trajectory.thought: The series has strong seasonality (strength 0.93) but highly unstable model ranking (tau 0.103), indicating that no single model consistently dominates. This instability suggests that robust combination methods which mitigate individual model failures are preferred over simple mean or weighted averages that might amplify errors from poorly performing models in specific windows. I will test a Trimmed Mean, which removes the worst-performing forecasts before averaging, to handle this instability and correlated error groups.

The series has strong seasonality and unstable model rankings across windows. The current best was a trimmed mean of all models, which is robust but potentially dilutes signal. I will test a weighted combination using inverse error weights, which emphasizes the better-performing models while still maintaining diversity, to see if it outperforms the simple trimmed mean.

I will test DBA on the full pool to see if it captures the consensus better than the current weighted approach.
